method: Offline arithmetic from a completed existing attempt. No browser, game state mutation, new simulation, test, forced GC or performance measurement is performed by this analyzer.

natural.quantileMethod: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*q. Minima are sampled natural occupied size, not measured post-GC live-object floors.
natural.windowDefinitions: First active<60. Last active>=finalActive-60, including terminal. Minute windows are [start,start+60); a final partial window is labelled.

decreases.largeReclamationCandidateRule: Decrease>=max(1 MiB,10% of preceding used size). This is a sampling heuristic, not GC event instrumentation.

postMeasurement.scope: After finished natural/frame measurement only. Real paused/menu/restart actions, 1.1-second settling, three forced GCs per checkpoint. Not natural-GC throughput.
postMeasurement.interpretation: Same-view collected changes are reported exactly. Both positive step deltas flag retention for source/heap-path review, not an automatic leak finding; one-time caches, profile updates and view identity must be considered. No numeric pass threshold is invented.

coverage.postMemoryMethod: After finished natural/frame measurement only. Real paused/menu/restart actions, 1.1-second settling, three forced GCs per checkpoint. Not natural-GC throughput.
coverage.offscreenBranchEvidence: Lung remained unactivated; this stationary-heart attempt did not exercise the activated offscreen-organ background ledger branch.
coverage.trueSettlementEvidence: The driver performs start/Q/pause/menu restarts after unfinished pressure; it is not repeated true RUN_ENDED settlement memory evidence. Profile recordedRunIds growth must be assessed separately.

finiteScopeInterpretation: This supplies a completed current-version ten-active-minute natural V8/DOM observation on the recorded machine and method. Runtime pass is a frame/pressure/input/source result and is not a memory verdict.
Used, allocated capacity, embedder and backing sizes remain separate. A capacity expansion alone does not prove retained object growth; a lone low terminal used value alone does not prove stability.

Read every-minute medians and minima with sampled decreases and matched post-GC menu checkpoints before making the finite AC-M16-04 memory conclusion. Report every actual positive delta and deliberate accounting root.
